# GeoPulse AI

AI-powered global intelligence platform combining real-time news aggregation, social signal analysis, geopolitical risk mapping, and AI-driven economic impact prediction.

## Key pages
- / — Hero and product overview
- /feed — Live intelligence feed of AI-clustered global events
- /globe — Interactive 3D world heatmap of country impact
- /social — Viral trends and market-moving social posts
- /dashboard — Personalized AI brief based on user interests
- /event/{id} — AI impact analysis and prediction timeline for a single event

## Notes
- All intelligence events are AI-generated via Lovable AI Gateway.
- Authentication is required to save events, vote, and personalize the dashboard.
